branch_protection.close_when: GitHub reports main protected=true and the required CI rule is enabled.

artifact_attestation.reason: GitHub supports signed artifact attestations, but the available connector cannot read back the repository attestation API needed to independently verify the result. CI write/OIDC permissions were not broadened without readback verification.
artifact_attestation.close_when: A signed provenance attestation is produced for retained release artifacts and can be independently read and verified in the active toolchain.

historical_repository_archival.close_when: Explicit human archive approval is recorded and every package remains archive_ready under the portfolio archive policy.
